scope: read-only consolidation of twelve completed continuous children and four fresh-process restoration observations; only JSON files opened

qualification.continuous_finite_execution: both model sizes, both precisions, three modes, three segments
qualification.paired_checkpoint_resume: four train witnesses within original thresholds; comparison is same precision and two owners in one process
qualification.fresh_process_restore: four single-owner load/first-update observations with finite/storage/step/detach checks; no paired trajectory equivalence

workload.topology: both are Settle, zero flush output slots; 0.5B and 1B have different topology/width, not a pure size sweep

timing.continuous: per-record complete_seconds includes selected-mode entire 136-input stream, and train adds full within-segment BPTT, loss, backward, AdamW, synchronization and state detach; first segment has no warmup
timing.boundaries: grad_forward retains graph within a segment and detaches between observations; train detaches at optimizer boundaries; subsequent segments continue private state
timing.decode: recorded stable_decode drops the first of eight decode calls; throughput is 7/sum(remaining seconds), median is separate; not a statistical stationarity claim
timing.aggregation: three complete times are sequential stateful segments, not IID repetitions; median is descriptive only; displayed memory maximum is max of three reported peaks
timing.fresh_restore: one cold first update per independent process; complete load/update includes phase allocator probes/bookkeeping, excludes on-disk records, checkpoint SHA pass, input setup and finite/storage validation
timing.checkpoint_resume: save_seconds/load_seconds belong to the in-process paired witness; no timed paired next-update sample recorded
timing.filesystem_cache: uncontrolled; fresh process does not imply cold filesystem cache

checkpoint_identity_scope: SHA256 and stat values are inherited from completed restore JSON after its measured load; expected hash arguments were null; this evidence pass neither opens nor stats checkpoint files
paired_input_hash_scope: continuous records hash the full 136-input tensor; the 64-input paired witness has no separate input hash field
precision_scope: declared FP32/BF16 policies are preserved; fresh records confirm actual FP32 parameters/gradients/AdamW storage and retained state dtypes; timed operator auditing is explicitly absent
resource_scope: cooperative exclusive queue for each job, external jobs uncontrolled; four CPU threads per process; actual physical mapping and host load retained

checks: programme result/config hashes and frozen math/source identity
six durable service and queue terminal states/resource mappings
all segment input/call counts, clock progression, prefill/decode arithmetic and finite flags
original eight checkpoint thresholds and mismatch sets
checkpoint path/recorded byte identity and before/after stat fields only
fresh finite scans, detached state and sampled updates
fresh complete intervals versus phases, combined peaks and input throughput

record.filesystem_cache: uncontrolled; fresh process does not imply cold filesystem cache; SHA pass runs after measured loading
record.comparison_qualification: one restored owner only; no original-owner reference, tolerance comparison or complete-trajectory equivalence claim
record.operator_dtype_observation: not instrumented in timed restoration; precision policy is explicit, operator qualification is separate
